name: Wall of Split Illumination — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Wall of Split Illumination from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Wall of Split Illumination" but are not part of the Wall of Split Illumination entry, which is unchanged.

Whereas the shadows that permeate the Material Plane merely denote the absence of light, the darkness of the Shadow Plane is in part created by the Negative Energy Plane. The Shadow Plane is home to beings and structures twisted by this influence into pale, quasi-real reflections of true creatures and objects native to the Material Plane. Closely tied to the forces that animate undead and abounding with phantasmal figments, shadow magic is heavily associated with the schools of illusion and necromancy. The following new spells use the energy of the Shadow Plane to fuel their effects.
